decisions.reason: The approved Hero V remains the unchanged master geometry; the requested alternatives modify only how the second V is derived from it.
The source requests second-V alternatives and does not change the locked É accent or its literal derivation from the Hero V terminal.
The requested second-V refinement must integrate with the alphabet, but it does not change the current E and L design requirements.
The second-V alternatives preserve the Hero V identity and do not explicitly replace or cancel the established shared terminal treatment.
The hierarchy effect is already represented by the same-message MODIFY selecting concepts #2 and #3 as the preferred relationship; the existing height constraints remain unchanged.
The source's separate spacing instruction is already captured by the same-message MODIFY establishing the L–V rhythm as the spacing benchmark.
The source does not change the required shared peak alignment between the approved Hero V and É accent.
Requesting a side-by-side second-V comparison does not change the standing requirement to explain design rationale with review rounds.
The source concerns black-and-white glyph geometry and spacing and does not resume or modify the deferred champagne material treatment.
The source does not discuss proof attachment formats or Mac compatibility.
